botcomponent.description: Renders an optional ephemeral standalone HTML card from a succeeded fact response using the approved Poutine League design tokens and strict escaping. Use when `includeHtml` is true, exact approval is verified, and synthesized facts are present. Do NOT use for other statuses, web retrieval, Dataverse reads or writes, persistence, or raw untrusted payloads.
botcomponent.name: Sanitized HTML Rendering
